title: Unfiltered Faith
author: Amanda Kristy
description:
Welcome to Unfiltered Faith, a Christ-centered podcast where real stories, raw conversations, and biblical truth come together.
Through powerful testimonies, honest discussions, and personal reflections, we explore what it truly means to follow Jesus in a world that often encourages us to do otherwise.
From seasons of struggle, doubt, and surrender to redemption, healing, and spiritual growth, we're talking about it ALL (without watering down the truth of God's Word).
No perfect people. No pretending. Just real faith, real conversations, & a perfect Savior. It's all about Jesus!

title: Between Wounds & Wisdom Podcast
author: David Coombs
description: Between Wounds & Wisdom explores the space between hurt and healing, intention and impact, perception and reality, accountability and understanding. Through stories, research and conversations on psychology, neurodivergence, trauma, relationships, gender and restorative justice, we examine what we fail to see in ourselves and each other—what we can own, take responsibility for, learn from and change, and how compassion and understanding can bridge the divide between men and women and foster healing, connection, reconciliation and repair. Different minds. Different experiences. Shared humanity.

title: The Brand Heretic
author: Ashley Briana Eve
description: What if everything you’ve been told about building a personal brand is wrong? Hosted by Ashley Briana Eve, The Brand Heretic explores the intersection of branding psychology, human behaviour, reputation, perception and cultural influence. From brand archetypes and the psychology of emotional connection to public relations, pop culture, and the strategies behind the world’s most recognizable brands, this is a deeper look at why people connect with certain brands, what makes them memorable, and what ultimately makes them worth choosing.

title: Swallow Talk Series
author: Sonal Pathak
description:
Swallow Talk Series is a conversation-based platform focused on dysphagia, swallowing science, and clinical practice in speech-language pathology. Each episode features leading clinicians, researchers, and educators discussing evidence-based practice, innovation, and real-world challenges across acute care, post-acute care, and research settings.
The goal is to bridge science and clinical practice while highlighting meaningful advances in swallowing rehabilitation, instrumental assessment, and patient-centered care.

title: Abnormally Close Podcast

description:
A gay brother and sister unpacking family dysfunction, toxic relationships, questionable relatives and the art of protecting your peace.
It’s family therapy, but cheaper! Although we’re definitely NOT qualified 👀

title: The Sanjay & Sarah Podcast
author: Soliman Productions
description:
Welcome to The Sanjay & Sarah Podcast—Behind the Business. Beyond the Marriage.

We’re Sanjay and Sarah—husband and wife, entrepreneurs, and two people with plenty to say. Join us for honest conversations about building businesses, navigating marriage, and figuring out life together.

From big ambitions and everyday disagreements to the lessons we’re still learning, we’re sharing our experiences, challenging each other’s perspectives, and making room for a little laughter along the way.

Marriage. Business. Life. No filter.

Subscribe and join the conversation. Whether you’re building a business, sharing life with a partner, or simply enjoy a candid discussion, pull up a seat.

title: Faithful Path Community
author: Pastor Richmond Kobe
description:
Biblical teaching on faith, dating and marriage with Pastor Richmond Kobe. Each episode opens the Scriptures to help Christian singles and couples choose wisely, love well and walk with Jesus in every part of life — from recognising red flags and green flags to understanding what it really means to be "equally yoked."
Go deeper with the guide Before You Say Yes: https://faithfulpathcommunity.com/guides/before-you-say-yes

title: Osh & Wheels
author: The Nation Network
description:
Former NHL stars T.J. Oshie and Blake Wheeler take you inside the game with their producer Brad Miller, delivering unfiltered opinions and unique analysis. From the biggest headlines to locker room stories, Oshie and Wheeler bring a player's perspective to the podcast space that’s different than most shows. With 2,182 combined NHL games, a Stanley Cup, and Olympic appearances, the duo offer an authentic opinion of the game.


Covering everything from the NHL and Team USA, this podcast will give fans a look at what’s really happening behind the scenes from two of the most accomplished American hockey players of their generation.


Watch the show Monday’s on the Daily Faceoff YouTube Channel.


Follow the show on socials @OshAndWheels


Thanks to our presenting partner FanDuel!

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The Eye Roll Effect
author: Stephanie Mendelson
description:
The Eye Roll Effect is a podcast that says what you are already thinking. For the moments that leave you speechless, the people who test every ounce of your patience and the situations that make you question humanity, let's roll our eyes and have a dose of inappropriate humor. 

I have lots of opinions to share, and a realization that there are plenty of people out there who also think the world has gone mad and roll their eyes all day long, looking around to not feel as if they are the only ones who see it.The Eye Roll Effect launched because we take ourselves too seriously. There is a plethora of absurdity out there and someone needs to address it, to laugh at it.  Real life is messy and exhausting but there is ALWAYS something to laugh about.Every episode is a conversation you'd have with your best friend, if your best friend happened to have a microphone and zero shame.

It is also a plaform for you to be part of the show. We want to hear from you! Send us your eye roll moments and stories or ask the advice of the Eye Roll Squad, we will be brutally honest!

title: pouwmuurisolatie Wevelgem
author: Spouwmuurisolatie Wevelgem
description:
Welkom bij de podcast van Spouwmuurisolatie Wevelgem, dé informatiebron voor iedereen die zijn woning energiezuiniger, comfortabeler en duurzamer wil maken. In onze afleveringen ontdek je alles over spouwmuurisolatie, energiebesparing en slimme isolatieoplossingen voor woningen in Wevelgem en omstreken.
Bij Spouwmuurisolatie Wevelgem delen we praktische tips, interessante inzichten en nuttig advies over het professioneel isoleren van spouwmuren. We bespreken verschillende isolatiematerialen, de voordelen van goede muurisolatie en hoe je warmteverlies en hoge energiefacturen kunt beperken.
Daarnaast beantwoorden we veelgestelde vragen over isolatiekosten, beschikbare premies, vochtproblemen en de invloed van spouwmuurisolatie op het wooncomfort. Ook leggen we uit hoe je kunt herkennen of jouw woning geschikt is voor spouwmuurisolatie en waarop je moet letten bij isolatiewerken.
Of je nu een oudere woning renoveert of gewoon minder energie wilt verbruiken, onze podcast helpt je om goed geïnformeerde keuzes te maken.
Luister mee en ontdek hoe kwalitatieve spouwmuurisolatie kan bijdragen aan een warmere woning, lagere energiekosten en een duurzamere toekomst.
Meer informatie over onze diensten en isolatieoplossingen vind je op onze website: https://spouwmuurisolatiewevelgem.com/.

title: Comfort Food
author: Amy Palanjian & Virginia Sole-Smith
description:
The podcast about the joys (and meltdowns!) of feeding our families and ourselves. Every week we examine how diet culture, body image issues and our own hectic lives get in the way of putting a dinner on the table that we can all feel good about. And we offer practical, road-tested tips to help you make peace with your own eating (or your kid's picky eating!) and find more joy in your family's food life. Hosted by best friends and writers Amy Palanjian (creator of the popular blog Yummy Toddler Food) and Virginia Sole-Smith (author of The Eating Instinct).

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Create a Sellable & Scalable Coaching Offer
author: The Intentional Impact Studio, LLC
description:
You know how to get incredible results for your clients—so why does packaging that brilliance into a scalable coaching offer feel so foreign?
Welcome to this audio series from The Intentional Impact Studio. Hosted by learning design experts Alix and Emily (who bring 20+ years of experience building 200+ courses and scaling 6- and 7-figure programs), this bingeable mini-series reveals how to take the messy, intuitive genius in your head and engineer a streamlined program that does the heavy lifting for you.
In under 10 minutes per episode, you’ll learn:
-Why struggling to scale isn’t an expertise or marketing problem—it’s a learning design problem.
-How to stop acting like a human textbook on live calls and eliminate the "Volume Equals Value" trap.
-The 5 Pillars of Transformation that create consistent client breakthroughs, skyrocket completion rates, and generate organic testimonials without burning out your calendar.
If you’re ready to welcome 2x or 3x the clients without increasing your working hours, hit play on Episode 1—and when you’re ready for direct, expert eyes on your curriculum, check out The Coaching Offer Accelerator at the link inside the show notes.

title: Built For Better
author: Adam Niffen
description:
Built For Better is a show about the spaces and systems that drive human performance, and the ones that hold us back.

I’m Adam Niffen. I’ve been studying this for over 15 years with one simple goal. Design spaces and systems that drive me to be a better performing human being. I’m an endurance athlete, a father, a husband and a family man. Most of all I’m a student of the mind, soul and spirit.

Three times a week we get into the science, the training, the faith and the structure behind high performance. We sit down with people working to be the highest performing humans they can be. And we take a hard look at the systems standing in the way, from food and healthcare to government, and what it takes to build new ones.

You’ll walk away with a deeper knowledge of self and a clearer picture of how to build a better human being.

title: No Flexibility Required
author: Bertena, Yoga Teacher
description: No Flexibility Required is the yoga podcast for beginners who think yoga is not for them. Hosted by Bertena of the Rose Temple Yoga School, this show offers gentle yoga guidance for people in larger bodies, people who have never taken a yoga class, and anyone who has ever felt too stiff, too old, or too out of place to begin.  Every episode meets you exactly where you are. You will find beginner friendly yoga explained in plain language, plus size yoga practices that honor the body you have today, chair yoga and gentle yoga options, and honest answers to the questions new students are afraid to ask.  New yoga teachers are welcome here too. Bertena shares what she has learned from years of teaching inclusive yoga for all bodies, so you can welcome every student who walks through your door with confidence.  You do not need to be flexible to start yoga. Flexibility is something yoga gives you, not something you need before you begin. Come as you are, and begin in the body you have.

title: Tidbits
author: Tidbits
description: Small facts that change how you see the everyday. Short trivia episodes about the human body, animals, psychology, world records, buildings, movies, and the lessons hidden in famous failures — companion podcast to the Tidbits blog (tidbits.symbode.com).

title: WWII Unwound: The Research Files
author: Alan Best
description:
Show title: WWII Unwound: The Research Files

Show description:

The deep dive for people who want the whole story of World War II, not just the headlines.

WWII Unwound: The Research Files takes one subject at a time and goes all the way in. It covers the weapons and how they worked, the doctrine behind them, the numbers that matter, and the arguments historians still have. Each episode starts with a single research file, such as a battle, a machine, a campaign or a decision, and then follows the evidence.

Amanda asks the questions a curious listener would ask. Harry, our historian, answers with the detail military history enthusiasts want. Your host, Alan Best, is a U.S. Navy veteran, author and historian.

If you enjoy WWII Unwound and want more depth, this show is for you.

New episodes are on your favorite podcast app. Visit www.beststorypublishing.com or write to BestStoryPublishing@gmail.com.

A production of the Best Story Publishing Podcast Network.

Hear why “Don’t Hold Up the Line—Know What’s on Your Ballot” matters and how a little preparation can help keep voting lines moving, as well as how Coordinator Goins got to where he is today.

The world is on fire. And sometimes peace comes in the strangest of places. When was the last time you checked your junk?

Join best friends and renowned queers Eva Scott and Joseph Aldous as they dive into their junk inboxes every week, and find little nuggets of gold — and meaning — amidst all the rubble. 

This is Show Us Your Junk.

Here, we unplug from fear-driven narratives about technology and imagine what becomes possible when we co-create with intelligence, organic and artificial alike.

title: Spouwmuurisolatie Ieper
author: Kris De Clercq
description:
Welkom bij de podcast van Spouwmuurisolatie Ieper, jouw informatiebron over spouwmuurisolatie, energiebesparing en comfortabel wonen in Ieper en omgeving. In onze afleveringen ontdek je hoe professionele spouwmuurisolatie jouw woning energiezuiniger, warmer en aangenamer kan maken.
Bij Spouwmuurisolatie Ieper delen we praktische tips, deskundige inzichten en nuttige informatie over het isoleren van spouwmuren. We bespreken verschillende isolatiematerialen, de voordelen van goede muurisolatie en manieren om warmteverlies te beperken. Ook beantwoorden we veelgestelde vragen over isolatiekosten, mogelijke premies, vochtproblemen en het verbeteren van de energieprestaties van jouw woning.
Of je nu een oudere woning wilt renoveren of jouw energiefactuur wilt verlagen, onze podcast helpt je om weloverwogen keuzes te maken. We leggen technische onderwerpen eenvoudig uit, zodat iedereen begrijpt waarom kwalitatieve spouwmuurisolatie een slimme investering kan zijn.
Met onze afleveringen willen we huiseigenaars inspireren om bewuster om te gaan met energie en wooncomfort. Ontdek welke isolatieoplossingen bij jouw woning passen en hoe je duurzame verbeteringen kunt realiseren.
Bezoek https://spouwmuurisolatieieper.com voor meer informatie over onze diensten en spouwmuurisolatie in Ieper. Luister mee en ontdek hoe je jouw woning toekomstgericht kunt isoleren.

What makes us trust something—or someone? I’m Beni Beeri Issembert. I build AI products, and I’m inviting people from technology, law, science and beyond to think this question through with me.
We’ll explore how trust is earned, what happens when it breaks, and what AI is changing about both.

author: Allie Cruse
description: I'm Allie Cruse, and alongside my husband Josh, we're exploring the hard-to-have conversations about love, sex, dating, and relationships that don't make it into health class or dinner table discussions. After years of navigating relationships away from God and eventually finding our way back to Him and His law, we have a lot of different perspectives on love, intimacy, and commitment. Through honest conversations, guests, and personal stories, we’re exploring the topics that deserve a LOT more attention!

title: Welcome to Wroxham

description:
Welcome to Wroxham is the podcast that takes you right into the heart of Wroxham FC.
From their vantage point in the Crows Nest at Trafford Park, commentators Nigel Westall and Tom Lorenzo keep a close eye on everything happening on and off the pitch. They report on the matches, share their observations and reactions, and speak to the staff, players and supporters to capture the stories, personalities and atmosphere that make Wroxham FC such a special club.

title: Understanding Trauma and C-PTSD
author: Idris Wyn Jones
description: Understanding Trauma explores childhood trauma, Complex PTSD, attachment, recovery, and the psychology behind emotional wellbeing. Combining lived experience with scientific research and counselling knowledge, each episode explains complex ideas in clear, everyday language by a qualified therapist, Idris Wyn Jones, author of 'Not an ordinary life '.

title: Almost Awake
author: Avery Jordan
description: Almost Awake is a podcast for people who think a lot and occasionally spiral about society, but in a fun way. This show explores culture, unspoken rules, and the weird systems we all live inside of. Expect thoughtful takes, personal stories, humor, and moments of “wait… why do we do this?” This isn’t about having life figured out, it’s about being curious, questioning the default, and choosing awareness over autopilot.

title: No Crying In Tech
author: No Crying In Tech
description:
Most tech news explains what happened. No Crying in Tech is a weekly tech podcast for women that explains what it actually means for you and what to do about it. Each week, we break down the biggest stories in AI, Silicon Valley, digital privacy, B2B and consumer tech through the lens mainstream coverage skips i.e the real impact on women's money, safety, health, and careers. 
Every episode ends with practical takeaways like settings to change, scams to spot, and smart moves to make right now so you own the tech, not the other way around. New episodes weekly. Follow now.

author: Roya Hakakian
description: “Remember This,” a weekly column about the cultural and intellectual life of the Middle East and North Africa through the people and works whose influence has endured across centuries.

title: The Sociology of Arts and Health
author: Dr Katey Warran
description: Despite global recognition of the role of the arts in improving health and wellbeing, sociologists are largely absent from this growing field of research, policy and practice. In this landmark short series, producer and host Katey Warran and her guests show what sociologists have to  offer to both practitioners and researchers. Addressing urgent issues including inequalities, rehabilitation, and mental health, they consider how sociology may deepen understanding of the intersections between arts, health and wellbeing.

title: The Elite Equine Edit
author: Elite Equine Marketplace
description: Two lifelong horse people, one honest conversation. Hosts Madi Sanders (founder of Elite Equine Marketplace) and Kaileigh Keen break down what's really happening in the horse world: the true cost of showing, horse shopping and vettings, adult amateur life, and the industry conversations happening in the barn aisle that nobody says out loud. Honest, funny, a little spicy, and always ending on something good. New episodes monthly.

title: The African Gourmet
author: The African Gourmet
description:
Welcome to The African Gourmet, where food is history, culture, memory, and identity.
Explore the diverse culinary traditions of Africa and the African diaspora through authentic recipes, food history, forgotten ingredients, ancestral cooking traditions, and the stories behind the dishes that connect generations and continents.

title: Trash Talk NYC
author: Trash Talk NYC
description: Welcome to the Trash Talk NYC podcast! We have conversations with sanitation workers, community leaders, and climate experts about cleaning our cities. Come along for the ride and learn how you can help your community.

title: Through Niels Lens - Episode 1
author: Louisa McGuinness
description:
Through Niels Lens - Episode 1: In His Own Words

Join Louisa for the first episode of Through Niels Lens, a podcast about her grandad, Birmingham press photographer Niels McGuinness. In His Own Words traces his early life, from Blackpool at fourteen, to Wednesbury, to the BSA factory, to photographing the Beatles, and to the start of a life behind the camera in Birmingham.

title: Mark and Paul's Opinion Hour
author: Mark Barron
description:
Have you ever thought that middle-aged, white, British men need a bigger platform from which to voice their opinions? No, neither did we. But here is a podcast full of that sort of thing anyway. Sorry/enjoy (delete as appropriate).


If you have anything to say about past or future episodes we would love to hear from you. Contact us at: markandpaulsopinionhour@gmail.com

author: Maya Thornton
description: A show about podcast trailers — how a still cover becomes a moving one without losing the host's face.

title: Real Talk Beyond Borders Podcast
author: Dr. Kim Conyers
description:
The world has enough filters. We’re here for the raw reality. >

Real Talk Beyond Borders is the audio home for the conversations most people are too afraid to have. We strip away the diplomatic polish to explore the gritty intersections of culture, self care, politics, spirituality and human experience across every time zone. No scripts, no agendas just unfiltered dialogue that bridges the gap between where you are and how the rest of the world actually thinks. Welcome to the conversation without boundaries.

title: The AVENORA Podcast
author: Rohid

Welcome to The AVENORA Podcast – Think Beyond. Grow Further.
Explore the world of business, entrepreneurship, innovation, technology, leadership, personal development, productivity, and success.
Every episode brings fresh ideas, practical knowledge, inspiring stories, and valuable insights to help you understand the world, develop new skills, and discover new opportunities.
Whether you're an entrepreneur, professional, student, creator, or lifelong learner, The AVENORA Podcast is your destination for meaningful knowledge and fresh perspectives.
Our mission is to inspire curiosity, encourage continuous learning, and share ideas that make a positive difference.
Discover Ideas. Build Knowledge. Inspire Growth.
The AVENORA Podcast – Think Beyond. Grow Further.

title: Thinnai Tales
author: Ti
description: Welcome to Thinnai Tales. This podcast is a personal journal exploring various thoughts, experiences and ideas that I come across. You get to eavesdrop into my cluttered, yet expansive mind and my world. I don't have a plan for this space, you can expect some random experiences, philosophies, stories, sometimes nothing significant at all. Sometimes you might just hear me rambling about life and the universe. But stay with me, I might just keep you entertained and in the process you might get to hear or get a peek into my mind and its fascinating encounters.

title: Pithy Bill's Public School
author: Mr. Bray Labs
description: Well, butter my biscuit and call it a school day — welcome to Pithy Bill's Public School, the daily game-show podcast where Pithy Bill the Truthy Pill spins the Word Wheel and teaches one southern word a day. Play Two Lies & a Truthy Pill, swallow the real definition and its fact-checked origin, and learn to say it like you mean it. 365 episodes — one word for every day of the year — built on grades 4–5 figurative language, made for families, classrooms, and anybody decoding Grandpa. New episodes daily at 11:00 AM CT. A Public Access Channel 850 production. © Mr. Bray Labs Corp.

title: Lamplit Sleep Stories
author: Lamplit Sleep Stories
description: Lamplit Sleep Stories tells slow, true stories from the ancient world, softly, for the end of your day. Each video follows one night through old cities, from Rome and Egypt to Greece, China, Mesopotamia and the Indus Valley, with calm narration and gentle music. Narration is synthetic, images and music are AI-generated, and every script is written with AI assistance and checked by a human editor. Sources are listed in each video description.

title: Ground Zero by Adarsh
author: Adarsh Singh
description:
Welcome to Ground Zero by Adarsh. Every major headline has a hidden backstory. Ground Zero is an investigative, research-driven podcast that goes beyond breaking news to uncover why global events actually happen. From massive tech outages and market shifts to deep-dive industry investigations, every episode traces the root cause, unpacks verified data, and exposes the real pros, cons, and power dynamics behind the stories shaping India and the world, without the media noise. New deep-dive episodes every week. Hit Follow so you never miss what’s really happening beneath the surface.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Relax for a while
author: Relax for a while
description: Bedtime stories for sleep, gentle anxiety and panic talk-downs, and guided relaxation to help calm the mind and support restful sleep. Welcome! I’m Joanne, creator of Relax for a while and the voice behind the Drift Off Bedtime Stories podcast. This channel is a calm place to land, offering soothing storytelling, calming support, and gentle audio created to help you unwind and rest. Unwind with relaxing bedtime stories, thoughtfully adapted from public-domain literature and narrated in a soft, unhurried style. Each story is designed to be easy to listen to, comforting, and safe for sleep. You’ll also find supportive videos for moments of anxiety or panic, offering grounding and reassurance. Many videos begin with a short relaxation to help quiet the mind and gently guide you toward rest.

title: Biomedica Healthcare
author: Biomedica Healthcare
description: Setting up a nursing lab requires the right equipment to support clear demonstrations and regular practice. We helps nursing colleges and training institutes create learning spaces with suitable manikins, anatomy models, hospital beds, CPR trainers and essential clinical teaching aids. Each item plays a role in helping students understand nursing procedures, patient care and basic clinical skills. Biomedica Healthcare offers a range of nursing education products for institutions planning new labs or improving existing facilities. Support is available with product selection, lab planning, delivery coordination and after-sales assistance. Equipment choices can be considered according to course requirements, student strength, available space and budget. A well-planned lab gives students a better setting to learn and practise.

title: Found Trusted Booked
author: Angela Stewart
description:
Your next client is asking Google and AI who to work with. Are you on the list?
Found. Trusted. Booked. is the podcast for coaches, consultants and service-based businesses who are brilliant at what they do but aren’t getting the enquiries they deserve. I’m Angie Stewart, a Search & AI Visibility Strategist with over 17 years in digital marketing, and I help you turn your expertise into enquiries.
Each episode covers one thing that helps you get found on Google, show up in AI search tools like ChatGPT, and build the trust that turns a search into a booking. No jargon and no tricks, just clear, practical advice, real examples and a simple task to try.
New short episodes every Monday, Wednesday and Friday, each one easy to listen to over a cuppa.

title: Pickin' Six
author: Aiden Wasson
description:
Pickin Six, hosted by Aiden Wasson, is a podcast covering all things College Football. Aiden believes College Football is much more than just the top 25, or top 12 teams for that matter. College Football was and still is about the little guy. 
Sure, the CFP is fun and pivotal matchups between ranked teams are entertaining, but what about the electric matchups on a thursday night between two schools you've never heard of? 
Aiden's goal is to bring attention to those games, provide commentary for those games, and give you a dog in the fight for the little schools.

title: Zoratee
author: zoratee.com
description: Welcome to The Art of Expression: Unveiling Zoratee, the podcast that dives deep into the world of personal fashion and creative storytelling. Fashion is more than just fabric; it is a canvas for your personality, a reflection of your hobbies, and a way to celebrate life's most meaningful moments. Throughout this series, we explore how graphic tees, hoodies, and unique apparel can transform your everyday wardrobe into a vibrant statement of who you are. We discuss the inspiration behind our diverse collections at https://zoratee.com/

title: the haunted getAwayZ
author: the haunted getAwayZ
description:
Real hauntings. European destinations. All under 10 minutes.


 The Haunted getAwayZ uncovers chilling stories from haunted hotels, castles, Airbnbs—and the places you walk by without even realizing what happened there.
 Every episode dives into real accounts of paranormal encounters, folklore, and ghost stories we’ve uncovered through obsessive research, internet rabbit holes, and firsthand tips from fellow travelers.
 Whether it’s a cursed inn in the Alps or a ghostly figure in a city square, if it gave someone chills—we’re talking about it.


 👻 Quick, eerie, and just enough to make you rethink your next stay.

title: Pregnancy & Postnatal Entrepreneurs Collective Podcast
author: Niamh Cassidy, IBCLC
description:
The Pregnancy & Postnatal Entrepreneurs Collective Podcast, in conjunction with Your Birth Biz, is a podcast for birth and postpartum professionals who want to grow sustainable, ethical businesses without burning out or losing themselves along the way.


Hosted by Niamh Cassidy, childbirth educator, IBCLC lactation consultant, and business coach to birth workers, this podcast sits at the intersection of business, birth work, values, and real life.


Niamh started her own perinatal business as a side hustle while working full-time in social care, and knows first-hand how challenging it can be to fill classes, attract clients, and stay confident when everyone else seems to be “doing better”. She’s been through the comparison spiral, the over-consumption of business advice, and the frustration of learning from business spaces that don’t understand the ethics, boundaries, and responsibilities of perinatal work.

Through years of learning, testing, adapting (and unlearning), Niamh has built a fully booked lactation practice and successful education and coaching business — without resorting to fear-based marketing, unethical tactics, or stepping away from client work she loves.


This podcast is a mix of:

  • Solo episodes on business, mindset, visibility, boundaries, and sustainability
  • Guest conversations with birth workers and women in business
  • Panel discussions exploring nuanced topics at the crossover of business and birth work

Expect honest conversations, thoughtful critique of “one-size-fits-all” business advice, and practical insights you can actually apply to your own practice.

If you’re a doula, lactation consultant, antenatal educator, or perinatal professional who wants to grow a business that feels aligned, ethical, and genuinely supportive — you’re in the right place.

title: Angeles Cuidadores
author: Fundación Almas Grandes
description:
En Angeles Cuidadores exploramos todo lo que necesitas saber para elegir el mejor hogar geriátrico y asegurar el bienestar de tus seres queridos. 
Consejos prácticos, entrevistas con especialistas en geriatría y relatos de vida que inspiran. 
Únete a nosotros y descubre cómo crear un espacio de salud, comodidad y calidez para el adulto mayor.

title: MetaMarkets - The European lens on crypto, macro-finance, and regulation.
author: metamarkets
description:
MetaMarkets is the European lens on macro-finance and digital assets. We cover capital markets, crypto regulation, and the frequently overlooked geopolitical implications of financial policy. This podcast maps out the forces shaping today’s economic landscape. 
Jan Fritsche and Jón Egilsson host the show. They bring a rare combination of central banking leadership, economic research, crypto entrepreneurship, and Web3 cybersecurity expertise.
Dr. Jan Philipp Fritsche is a co-founder of Bermuda, a compliant privacy solution for Ethereum, and the Strategic Director at Oak Security, a Web3 cybersecurity firm that pioneered economic attack vectors in decentralized systems. Jan worked at the European Central Bank, Bundesbank, Deutsche Bank, and served on the European Commission’s Monetary Expert Panel. He holds a Ph.D. in Economics.
Jón Egilsson served as Chairman of the Central Bank of Iceland following the 2008 financial crisis. He is also the co-founder and chairman of Monerium, the first company to issue fiat currency on-chain. Jón holds a Ph.D. in Economics and a master’s in Engineering. He teaches at King’s Business School and regularly contributes to Forbes, writing on stablecoins, digital currencies, and monetary sovereignty.

title: Letters from INFINITUM | mugen
author: mugen x
description:
Hello lovely people :)


I'm mugen and welcome to my podcast. A little chaos is good medicine :) This is a new medium and I'm a curious non-linear thinker that likes to see where the connections/threads take us, I'd like to hear from you to know what shape this wants to take and have fun with it!


What do you want to know? What do you want to hear? If you heard something interesting, let's get into it and see where it goes.


Before this, I tattooed for 10 years, got my masters/license in Chinese Medicine and Acupuncture and have now pivoted into writing and podcasting. I'm in a new era in my life and want to share my strange brain and stories with you all.


Thanks for listening and please feel free to leave feedback! All my work is my full-time job as an artist, writer, and creative. This is a listener supported podcast, so if this interests you, brings some laughter, knowledge, insight into your world, please consider making an offer or subscription through Patreon and/or support my work through Substack.


In gratitude and much love <3

title: Cheese Louise
author: Nick and Jenny
description:
Welcome to Cheese Louise, the podcast that unlocks the mysteries of the Romantiverse one trope at a time.

What’s the Romantiverse? It’s the world of Hallmark, Lifetime, Reel One, and MarVista. A place where nutcrackers come to life looking for love, Santa can’t mind his own damn business, and a small town bakery can somehow make 15,000 cookies for the Army.

Every week, Nick and Jenny lovingly roast one of these movies, mix a cocktail to go with it, and play a round of Romantiverse Bingo. And when a movie gets them, they’ll admit it. Eventually.

So come along and settle in. You were gonna watch it anyway why not watch with us,

description:
“Our Thin Space” Podcast brings you conversations from our home in Girona in Spain with artists, makers, thinkers and friends about wonder, creativity, story and restoration.
Conversations (in English, Catalan & Spanish) that might help us look again at the places we live, the things we create, the stories we believe, and the lives we’re becoming.

description:
Small dog. Big thoughts.
Lucas is a little Havapoo with big thoughts about the world. Every Saturday, join him for a gentle read-aloud storybook— made for kids ages 3 to 6, for bedtime, car rides, and quiet mornings. Each story teaches one new word in Spanish, and ends with a question to talk about together.

Because it's never too late to discover new possibilities, chase new dreams, and create a life you love. She's Not Done Yet, and neither are YOU!sd

title: AI. Mal ehrlich
author: Sven Bartheidel
description:
Was kann Künstliche Intelligenz wirklich und was ist eigentlich nur Hype?

In „AI. Mal ehrlich“ sprechen Oliver und Sven offen, neugierig und ohne Buzzword-Bingo über die Chancen, Herausforderungen und manchmal auch unbequemen Fragen rund um AI.

Dabei holen sie regelmäßig spannende Gäste ans Mikro: Entscheider:innen aus der Industrie, Stimmen aus Bildung und Wissenschaft sowie AI-Expert:innen, die wissen, was heute schon möglich ist und was vielleicht morgen kommt.

title: Work: Truths and Lies
author: Work Truths and Lies.
description:
**Work Truths and Lies** explores the realities of today's workplace, uncovering the ideas, assumptions, and misconceptions that shape how we work, lead, and do business.
From workplace culture and leadership challenges to employee engagement, business psychology, team dynamics, and professional growth, each episode takes a closer look at what really happens behind the scenes of working life. Through insightful discussions, expert perspectives, real-world experiences, and practical advice, we separate workplace facts from popular myths and explore better ways to navigate the modern world of work.
Whether you're a business owner, manager, team leader, entrepreneur, or working professional, Work Truths and Lies brings you fresh perspectives and useful insights to help you make smarter decisions, build stronger workplace relationships, lead with confidence, and create a healthier, more productive work environment.
Because understanding the truth about work is the first step toward making work better.

Written by Clark Fumiatti

title: Reel Iron: The real stories behind the cars that stole the scene
author: ReelIron
description:
The real stories behind the cars that stole the scene.
DRAG-U-LA. KITT. The Munster Koach. The Monkeemobile. Every iconic vehicle from film and TV has a backstory wilder than the show it starred in — back-door deals, garage-built gambles, designers who got cheated out of credit, and machines that became more famous than the actors who drove them.
This channel digs up those stories. No filler. No recycled trivia. Just the real history, told the way it deserves to be told.
🔔 Subscribe for the cars Hollywood doesn't want you to forget.

description:

title: Beneath the Willow
author: MacKenzie
description:
For eight years, MacKenzie stood in courtrooms fighting for children in broken homes. In May 2026 she packed up that office and came home to build one. There was no last hearing, just boxes, a hallway, and people she had worked beside for eight years.
Beneath the Willow is where faith and family life meet honestly. Hosted by MacKenzie, it is for the woman devoted to her people and still figuring out what faithfulness looks like in the thick of it. Not a perfect woman. A present one.
New episodes twice a month. Come as you are. Grace is already here.

title: A Moment For Your Mind
author: Jon Carroll
description: Welcome to Ten Minute MindVibes, a MindVibesFM podcast exploring mental wellbeing, everyday challenges and the complicated business of being human. Season One, A Moment for Your Mind, offers honest, thought-provoking reflections on emotions, relationships, resilience, self-awareness and the way we think. Drawing on professional experience, lived experience and a little humour, each episode encourages fresh perspectives, healthier choices and a kinder understanding of ourselves and others. No lectures, no quick fixes, just ten minutes to pause, reflect and think differently.

Sapphic Lounge is where women fall for women, slowly and then all at once. Audio stories about the wrong woman at the right time, the boss you shouldn't want, the bartender who sees right through you, and the night you finally stop pretending.
Romantic, steamy, and made for adults. New episodes every Tuesday and Friday at 8 PM ET.

description: A short, honest morning show for millennial dads. AI assists with production and delivery; the ideas and opinions are theirs. See you out there.

author: Catherine Schultz, Ph.D.
description:
Awakened We Meetings is a podcast dedicated to supporting the evolution of human consciousness through exploring 3 simultaneous paths to experiencing Oneness with All That Is or bliss: 1) Individual Awakening (Who Am I?), 2) We Space Awakening of egoless shared unity (Who Are We?) and 3) Larger Human Collective Awakening (Who Is All?). 
The podcast contains in depth interviews with leaders in each of these three paths. Catherine also has written and sung the music album "Awakened We ~ Our Heritage" with songs to 'tune in' to an inspiring vision of what is possible for our species.

Three lifelong friends who were there revisit the records, gigs, bands and cultural upheavals that changed music forever. From the Pistols and The Damned to Talking Heads, Joy Division, The Cure and beyond, Jonathan, Paul and Gareth share memories, stories, arguments and a few laughs along the way. Starting in 1976 and travelling month by month from there, it's a personal journey through one of the most exciting periods in popular music — 50 years on.

Five Questions is a fast-moving podcast hosted by Diana Veiga and George Kevin Jordan —two writers, Kimbilio alums, and creative multi-hyphenates in conversation with artists, storytellers, and culture-makers.


Each episode blends pop culture, current events, and creative truth-telling, leading into our signature interview with a creative where we ask each one: four core questions and 1 wildcard question.


It’s a weekly space for creatives to get the spotlight, the strategy, and the celebration.

title: Brain Dump
author: Victoria
description: Welcome to Brain Dump, the podcast where all my hyper fixations get to become your problem, not just mine. Each episode, I pick a topic and let my thoughts run completely unchaperoned. Maybe I’ll talk about book boyfriends, maybe it’ll be the differences between a stay or corset. Who knows? Because I sure as hell don’t.

title: Mammon: The Believer's Authority Over Money
author: play pulse
description: Who owns your money — you, or it? Mammon is the podcast for every believer ready to take authority over money. Hosts Caleb and Grace walk through Derrick L. Shaw Sr.'s book "Mammon: The Believer's Authority Over Money" — four honest conversations on ownership, the power of your words, sowing with authority, and walking free. "Ye cannot serve God and mammon" (Matthew 6:24). New episodes weekly. Subscribe, and take your seat as the heir.

title: The Faith Infusion Podcast
author: Demetria Lea
description:
Real life will make you ask some real questions—and we’re making room for them.

Join Elder Demetria Lea on The Faith Infusion Podcast for honest conversations about loving God while navigating disappointment, waiting, uncertainty, and everyday life. Through biblical truth, personal experiences, and practical reflection, we explore the feelings and questions we don’t always know how to talk about as Christians.

You don’t have to pretend to have it all together here. Come as you are, think it through with us, and discover what faith looks like beyond Sunday morning.

title: Cashflow Ninja
author: M.C Laubscher
description: In Cashflow Ninja, host M.C. Laubscher, renowned as a leading expert in alternative investment strategies and alternative asset investing, interviews the best global minds in business and investing that share alternative wealth strategies and alternative asset investing niches. The mission of the Cashflow Ninja is to empower people to create, protect & multiply their wealth in the new economy and information age. The rules of money have changed and we share the new rules and how anyone can create, protect and multiply their wealth in our constantly changing environment.

title: Pine and Raz (and video games)
author: Iron Pineapple and Razbuten
description: A podcast hosted by Iron Pineapple and Razbuten where they talk about video games.

title: The Fine Print: exposing the systems that skim money
author: The Fine Print
description: Legal. Deliberate. Expensive. Fine Print exposes the systems, industries, and institutions designed to skim money from ordinary people — and the people who built them.

title: Resilience Through Prayer
author: Ashley Jordan
description: Join Ashley Jordan every Thursday night at 8:00 PM Eastern on Talking with Ashley Jordan for an encouraging time of Bible study, prayer, and spiritual growth!Inspired by the book Resilience Through Prayer: 30 Days of Spiritual Strength, Breakthrough, and Renewal.Together, we will explore God's Word, strengthen our faith, overcome life's challenges, and learn how to build ourselves spiritually, mentally, and emotionally. luk.bio/AshleyJordanMinistries

title: Damn Good Company
author: Primitive.
description: Damn Good Company is a podcast from Primitive, hosted by Chris Cook. Each episode is a real conversation with someone worth listening to. One month it’s a business owner here in Lubbock, the next it’s a musician or a civic leader from across West Texas. There’s no script and no sales pitch. Chris sits down with people who are building something and lets the conversation go where it goes. You’ll come away entertained, and usually with an idea you can use. New episodes every month.

title: Air It Out With Pac Man
author: Robert Bruchun
description: Robert Bruchun, also known as Pac Man, talks with artists, community leaders, and neighbors in Shreveport, Bossier City, and across Louisiana. Hear full interviews about music, local politics, and the people shaping the 318.

title: Cap Space Podcast
author: Cap Space Podcast
description: Highlighting former hockey players in their post-sport careers. Cap Space is a community geared towards players making room for what comes next.

title: Now You See It
author: Now You See It
description:
Essays exploring film, storytelling, and the techniques that shape what we watch.

Links:
twitter: https://twitter.com/jacknugent27
patreon: https://www.patreon.com/nowyouseeit?ty=h
reddit: https://www.reddit.com/user/27jackstreet

title: Savannah Sessions Podcast
author: Chelsea Williams | Dee Daniels Media Podcast Network
description:
Savannah, Georgia, is full of larger-than-life characters with stories you’ll have to hear to believe.
Hosted by Savannah native Chelsea Williams, The Savannah Sessions Podcast brings you real, unfiltered conversations with the people who make the Hostess City special. From founders and innovators to mischief makers and keepers of local lore, Chelsea uncovers the fascinating personalities, unexpected connections, and untold stories that deserve another generation.
Hospitality is in Chelsea’s blood. Raised in a family that has been part of Savannah’s restaurant scene for 50 years, she grew up hearing legendary tall tales and unforgettable stories around the dinner table and at the corner of the bar. Now, she’s bringing those conversations to you.
Recorded on location throughout Savannah, each episode offers an intimate look at the people behind the stories. With warmth, curiosity, humor, and a little mischief, Chelsea goes beyond the usual introductions to uncover what makes these people and this city so special.
Whether you’re a lifelong local or simply someone who loves Savannah, pull up a chair and join the conversation.
The Savannah Sessions Podcast: Savannah’s stories, told by the local legends who lived them.

title: Access Forward
author: Pope Tech
description: Access Forward, a Pope Tech podcast about the stories of accessibility. Hosted by Paralympic triathlete Taylor Talbot and Jay Pope, Web Accessibility Specialist & CEO of Pope Tech, the show explores accessibility through personal stories, expert insights, and meaningful conversations. From technology and education to everyday experiences, we explore how accessibility creates opportunities and makes the world better for everyone. Transcripts and show notes: https://www.pope.tech/podcast

title: GILDtalks
author: GILD| Great Indian Legal Diaries
description: GILD - Great Indian Legal Diaries, is a closer look at the people, cases and moments that shape the law in India. From landmark judgments and defining arguments to the voices behind them, GILD explores the stories and perspectives that often remain beyond the headlines. Through conversations with experienced voices from the legal fraternity, each episode offers a thoughtful lens on the practice, people and evolving landscape of Indian law.

title: African life Stories
author: Kwarteng Owusu Sekyere
description: Hello everybody, I am Kwarteng Owusu and I want to share what over the years I have learnt and experienced as an African with you guys. African life stories will be talking about the decisions we as Africans and the Youth as a whole. What to do as a Continent and what to do as a Nation (Ghana) to develop ourselves both individually and collectively. I will also be talking about the the various assaults raising against Africans over the years and the topics which are very common in our community and things which are gaining waves in the world. I will also talk about great African leaders.

title: It's Nobody's Business
author: itsnobodysbusiness
description:
It's nobody's business... but here we are.

I'm Sabrina, an Greater Manchester girl with Jamaican roots, a creative mind and plenty to say.
By day, I work in SEO and digital content. Outside the 9-to-5, I'm juggling a beauty business, content creation and whatever new idea I've come up with that week.

I've never been one for sticking to just one thing, so why start now?

From careers, confidence and creativity to beauty, relationships, pop culture, everyday life and the odd random rant, we'll be getting into a bit of everything.

Expect honest opinions, personal stories, useful tips, the occasional guest and probably a few conversations that go completely off track.

I'm quite a private person, believe it or not, so don't expect me to tell you absolutely everything. But I've learnt a few things along the way, and I've definitely got some opinions.
Some things are nobody's business. The rest? Well, we might as well have a chat.


Become a supporter of this podcast: https://www.spreaker.com/podcast/it-s-nobody-s-business--7587458/support.

title: Aunty Arike Wellness Series
author: Adesunbo Adeniran
description: The Aunty Arike Wellness Series is an exclusive, limited podcast. where exclusive living meets holistic health. Hosted by your wellness guide Adesunbo Adeniran aka Aunty Arike, founder of Arike Botanicals, this podcast delivers elegant routines, timeless wisdom, and nature’s finest remedies to empower your body, mind, and spirit. guiding you to a life of empowerment, balance, and success. From routines that anchor your day, to herbs that fuel your energy, to joy that heals the soul, this series transforms wellness into wealth.

title: WW2 Diaries: unfiltered experiences of the Second World War
author: WW2 Diaries
description:
Welcome to "WW2 Diaries" - Step back into the world of courage, chaos, and sacrifice that shaped the modern era. WW2 Diaries brings to life the raw and unfiltered experiences of those who fought, commanded, and endured through the Second World War.
Each video opens a window into the personal journals, letters, and forgotten testimonies of soldiers, nurses, pilots, and civilians caught in the storm. From the trenches of Europe to the jungles of the Pacific, we uncover the moments of humanity behind the headlines—the fear, the faith, the heartbreak, and the hope that endured amid unimaginable destruction.
Join us as we turn the pages of history’s most personal accounts, revealing the truth of war not through textbooks, but through the words of those who lived it.

title: Second Voice
author: Francesca Fini
description: You love a mystery that pulls you in and won't let go. Second Voice is an audio drama where a dubbing actress is hired to rebuild the voice of a woman who vanished five winters ago on a frozen lake. Then the script gives her a line only the missing woman could know.

title: Happily Ever Appalachia
author: Happily Ever Appalachia
description: Hosts Paige and Kaylee review romantasy reads using Appalachian-based ratings, discuss their take on common tropes, and share holler stories and life in central Appalachia.

title: PEAK with Patricia
author: Patricia A.
description:
Welcome to PEAK with Patricia — Personal Elevation And Knowledge.
I’m an attorney, a leader, and a lifelong student of human behavior. Through real stories, honest conversations, humor, and lessons life has taught me, we’ll explore relationships, leadership, fear, success, and what it means to reach our potential.
I’m not here to tell you what to think. I’m here to get you thinking, questioning, and growing.
Because the rebellion starts in your mind.
And we’ll end every episode with three things we’re grateful for.
Independent of my legal practice. Not legal advice.

title: Historyman
author: historyman1781
description: American Revolutionary War History, Southern Campaigns, Where we walk in the footsteps of heroes and proclaim Freedom Reigns

title: Yah We Rise! Podcast
author: Shaquan Woody
description: The Bible says that the Earth groans for more of God’s servants to rise and serve! Learn how rise into a whole new realm of the Kingdom of God!

title: Johnny Poo & ME
author: John Polo
description: Real stories, big feelings, and a whole lot of heart - here to help you believe in yourself & what this life could be. This is Johnny Poo & ME.

title: The P Henny Show
author: P Henny
description: The P Henny Show is a weekly podcast hosted by songwriter P Henny and the esteemed Mr. Orangutan. Each episode, P Henny will discuss a different aspect of the craft of songwriting and play his own songs to illustrate his points. New episode every Friday!

title: The AlgoRHYthm
author: Dr. Jaime Kowlessar
description: Welcome to The AlgoRhythm, where the cipher meets the pulpit. Hosted by Dr. Jaime Kowlessar, pastor, hip hop scholar, and founder of Raise Your Voice, Inc. Each episode sits at the intersection of hip hop, faith, and justice, tracing the real history, the real cases, and the real numbers behind the culture, and asking what they demand of us now.

title: The Wealthy Beach Bum: Retirement Planning Made Simple
author: Al Costanzo
description:
What does your ideal retirement look like? Maybe it's mornings on the golf course, afternoons by the water, or simply having the freedom to spend your days however you choose. Whatever your version of paradise looks like, a great retirement starts with a financial plan that helps you get there. 


Welcome to The Wealthy Beach Bum: Retirement Planning Made Simple with Al Costanzo, financial advisor, president of Costanzo Financial Advisors, and author of How to Retire Like a Beach Bum. 


Each episode, Al takes the complexity out of retirement planning with straightforward conversations about retirement income, Social Security, taxes, investing, market risk, and protecting the wealth you've worked hard to build. 


Retire like a beach bum. Plan like a pro. To learn more, visit our website https://costanzofa.com/ or call (727) 335-1608.

title: She Was Here
author: Jessica
description:
Before she became a headline, she was someone.
SHE WAS HERE is a true-crime documentary podcast hosted by Jessica, telling the stories of women whose lives were cut short.
We explore who they were, what happened, the search for answers, and the legacies they left behind.
These women were more than victims. They were daughters, mothers, sisters, friends, and people with dreams.
New episodes every two weeks. Facebook subscribers get early access, with public releases the following Monday.
Remember the woman, not just the tragedy. Because she was here.

title: Perspective
author: Rikesh Lallu
description:
What if your darkest moments aren't a breakdown but an awakening?
Welcome to Perspective. Born from my own journey through severe anxiety and the Dark Night of the Soul, this podcast bridges ancient wisdom, universal truths, and modern science, tying it all together with quantum physics, holistic and somatic methods of healing.
Every episode is 100% raw and unedited because life is imperfect, and real healing requires real truth. Through raw reflections and interviews, we explore consciousness beyond modern day medication. Tune in and step into a new way of seeing yourself and the Universe.

title: Adam Schefter on Altitude
author: KSE Radio Ventures
description: ESPN Senior NFL Insider Adam Schefter joins Altitude Sports Radio for the latest on the Broncos and what's happening inside the National Football League

title: The OPScura Show
author: The OPScura Show
description:
The OPScura Show explores the intersection of Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT), privacy, and security. We dig into the information hiding in plain sight — and the things better kept out of it. From investigative techniques to everyday digital defenses to physical security methods, we examine what your data reveals, how to limit your exposure, and how to protect what matters.
Here on The OPScura Show the mission is simple: procure the procurable, obscure the obscurable, and secure the securable.

title: Clinic Growth Explored
author: Vishnu Swaroop Lal
description:
Your patients start with a worry, not a treatment name. Clinic Growth Explored shows aesthetic clinics, med spas and medical clinics how patients find a clinic today—and how to be the one they choose.
Each episode covers one step: AI search, patient questions, content, ads or follow-up that turns enquiries into bookings. Full video links are in the episode notes.
Hosted by Vishnu Swaroop Lal, clinic growth expert and founder of MangoEyes. His team has worked inside clinics for six and a half years, spending over £7.8 million and generating £45 million for clinics.

title: Vibe Mode
author: Vibe Mode
description: Vibe Mode is a podcast about design in the age of AI. Every episode, we explore how AI is changing the way we design websites, interfaces, motion and video, from the tools worth trying to the workflows that actually ship. It's for designers, builders and the curious who want to create faster without losing their taste. Less theory, more making: switch on Vibe Mode.

title: 74 Gear
author: 74 Gear
description:
A pilot's perspective on aviation, flying, and the stories behind aircraft and airline operations.

Links:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/74gear/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/74gear/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/74gear

title: MobLand Podcast
author: Chris Watts
description:
If you've watched MobLand and want to dig deeper into what's happening, this is where Chris Watts talks through every episode and character from Guy Ritchie's show. Get the details you might have missed and hear from someone who loves the story as much as you do.


MobLand Podcast is a podcast made by a MobLand fan for MobLand fans!

title: The Controls Floor Podcast
author: Markus 864
description: For maintenance techs, controls techs and students who want to use AI on real automation work. Each episode takes one question from the plant, like whether logic an AI wrote should go into a running machine, and talks it through until you know what to check before you trust it. You'll pick up how to use AI to troubleshoot, read a program you've never seen and write logic on any platform, and how to catch it when it gets the rung wrong. Hosted by Markus with Ray and Tyler, two AI characters. Join the community free on Skool: skool.com/the-controls-floor-6266

title: Jane's Online Teaching Adventures
author: Jane
description: A method for teaching online during social/physical isolation periods.

title: AMEC Podcast: Value Through Data
author: Johna Burke
description: Welcome to Value Through Data, the official podcast from AMEC, the International Association for Measurement and Evaluation of Communication. Hosted by Johna Burke, CEO and Global Managing Director of AMEC, this podcast brings together leading experts, researchers, communication professionals and innovators to explore how evidence, research, measurement and evaluation drive better decisions and stronger business outcomes.

title: Builder Manifesto
author: Andrew Kordampalos
description:
The best builders in AI don't fit one title. They're PM, engineer, designer and GTM, all in one person, and they're outshipping teams of twenty.
Builder Manifesto is a podcast about them. Each episode, Andrew Kordampalos sits down with a builder to talk about how they actually work: what they ship, how they decide what to build, the AI tools in their stack, and what it takes to think across product, engineering and go-to-market.
Hosted by Andrew Kordampalos (AI Growth at Zapier). buildermanifesto.com

title: Failing Upwards
author: Jon Pepper
description:
Somebody in charge has no idea what they’re doing, but you’ve noticed. 

Jon Pepper wrote six novels about it.

Failing Upward goes inside the boardrooms, campaigns, and newsrooms where ego outruns competence, and finds the comedy hiding in plain sight.

Jon has worked both sides: business columnist at The Detroit News, morning radio host, and executive in the energy and automotive industries. Now he writes satire Kirkus calls “satirically sharp,” including his latest, Run Robbie Run, about a clueless billionaire recruited to run for president.

title: Wild Archaeology
author: Bryan
description: Wild Archaeology is hosted by Bryan Hunt with retired archaeologist Ken Wild, who has worked at south eastern US national parks and Caribbean historic sites. Learn the stories hidden in grey literature and gain a deeper understanding of these places before your next visit.

title: Parenting with Purpose
author: Coty Dunaway
description:
Raising kids in today’s world takes intentionality, grace, and a whole lot of community. Welcome to Parenting with Purpose, hosted by Coty and Hannah Dunaway of the First Baptist Church of Ripley.
This podcast is your go-to audio resource for navigating every stage of family life. Whether we are exploring foundational truths, tackling real-world parenting challenges, or sharing practical tips for discipling your kids at home and in the community, every episode is designed to equip you for the journey.
Grab a cup of coffee and join us as we figure out how to point our children toward Christ

title: Izračun postotka
author: Lazar Bukejlovic
description: Izračun postotka je podcast na hrvatskom jeziku koji na jednostavan i praktičan način objašnjava kako izračunati postotak u svakodnevnim situacijama — od popusta u trgovini i napojnica do kamata, poreza i poslovnih izračuna. Kratke i jasne epizode pomažu slušateljima da brzo nauče formule i primjere koje mogu odmah primijeniti.

title: On the Frontlines: Georgia Republican Politics
author: The Georgia Republican Assembly
description: On the Frontlines is a podcast that presents information behind the scenes with activists who are on the frontlines to oppose political corruption in Georgia. This product is brought to you by the Georgia Republican Assembly.

title: 9-1-1 Unfiltered
author: NCT9-1-1
description: Real Conversations. Real People. Real 9-1-1.

title: Life in the Arena
author: Jace Young
description: Building a business, raising kids, and fighting for a strong marriage, all at the same time. Jace Young calls it the trifecta of insanity. On Life in the Arena, the founder and CEO of Legacy Farmer shares raw stories, hard lessons, and the faith that keeps him in the fight. Short episodes for anyone who's in the arena right now.

title: The Wellness Edge with Sandi Edghill
author: Cassandra "Sandi" Edghill, MPA, ACC
description:
The Wellness Edge is a podcast about redefining success without losing yourself in the process.
Hosted by Executive Work Life Wellness Coach Sandi Edghill, each episode creates space for honest conversations about ambition, wellness, boundaries, identity, and what it really means to build a life that feels as good as it looks.
Through thoughtful reflections, practical insights, and real conversations, Sandi encourages women to slow down, check in with themselves, and make room for their own well-being while continuing to pursue meaningful goals.
The Wellness Edge is for women who are driven, accomplished, and ready to create success on their own terms without sacrificing their peace, health, or sense of self.
New episodes premiere Wednesdays at 12 Noon ET on Sistahs Connect Radio and are available on demand wherever you listen to podcasts. Listen live at sistahsconnect.com or download the Sistahs Connect Radio app from the Apple App Store or Google Play.
Learn more about Sandi and her coaching work at sandisedge.com.

title: No Context
author: YMH Studios
description: No Context follows comedian and renegade truth seeker Thomas Trussell on a quest to expose the secrets he swears the world isn’t ready for. Join him as he unravels shadowy plots, exposes forbidden knowledge, and uncovers clues from the digital underworld, all with the gleeful confidence of someone who definitely, probably, might know what he’s talking about.

title: Unhinged America: the wildest, weirdest, and most unbelievable facts about the Americas
author: Unhinged America
description: Welcome to Unhinged America — the channel dedicated to the wildest, weirdest, and most unbelievable facts about the Americas. We cover US states, world geography, bizarre history, and the kind of mind-blowing nature facts that your teachers definitely left out of the curriculum. From Florida's disappearing ground to Alaska's impossible geography, from the Amazon to the Arctic — if it's strange, surprising, and completely true, it belongs here. New videos every week. Drop a comment, cast your vote for the next video, and join the most unhinged geography community on YouTube.

title: Conversations with Constance
author: Constance Carter
description: Conversations with Constance is a wealth masterclass from those who built it from the ground up. The stories, the struggle, the sacrifice, and the strategy behind real success. This is where the wealth game is told, not sold.

title: Inside Line | Where the industry finds its edge
author: Snowsports Industries America
description: Inside Line is dedicated to bringing you the challenges and opportunities facing the winter outdoors. We bring a global perspective to business trends, climate impact, consumer behavior and the innovation that's transforming how we survive and thrive.

title: I Get Paid Friday
author: Yahri Shavers | Friday Money Media
description:
Cultural conversations with undertones of money.
On I Get Paid Friday, Yahri Shavers pulls back the curtain on what it really takes to build an exciting, elevated life as a woman today—and the financial decisions that make it all possible.
From career and ambition to beauty, relationships, and lifestyle, we explore the intersection of culture, money, and the cost of having it all.

title: The Crux
author: Joshua Ritchie
description: A podcast by Josh Ritchie where all Scripture is connected to Christ and then to your life. It’s time to get to the crux of the matter!

title: The AI Governance Playbook w/ Robert Smallwood
author: Robert Smallwoood
description: The AI Governance Playbook podcast w/ Robert Smallwood features interviews with AI and Information Governance leaders from around the globe, as well as discussions of AI & Information Governance news, events and best practices.

title: Water You Thinking
author: HASA, Orenda
description: Join Terry Arko, Jim Blanton, and Miguel Chavez on 'Water You Thinking', HASA's new podcast diving into swimming pool water chemistry, industry news and the myths pool pros hear every day.

title: FD Capital International
author: Adrian
description: Finance Leaders Abroad is the FD Capital International podcast for CFOs and Finance Directors working in, or thinking of moving to, the world’s international finance centres, from Dubai and Singapore to Bermuda, the Cayman Islands and the Channel Islands. Each episode covers what the move really involves: the role, the right to work, tax and pay, the regulator, and life on the ground.

title: Head in the Clouds by Head for Points
author: Head for Points
description:
Travel better with Rhys Jones and Jonathan Samuels. Each week, we cover the latest airline and hotel news and share practical ways to earn more Avios and air miles, whilst getting far more from the ones you have.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Code Squad
author: Elle J
description:
Code Squad is a podcast series of independent adventures following three gifted siblings—Sigge, Betty, and Bea—as they navigate bustling Manhattan to solve intriguing mysteries and help those in need. With their laptops, courage, and an unbreakable bond, they discover that almost any obstacle can be overcome through critical thinking and teamwork. Each adventure introduces young listeners to the power of asking the right questions and lessons about empathy, resilience, and the importance of community care.
This show is produced with AI text-to-speech. Episodes are edited by Elle J.

title: TSBOI Podcast: Supercharge Your Visibility
author: TSBOI
description:
The TSBOI Podcast is a weekly show about one problem: being invisible.

Every day, automated crawlers and AI-powered search tools go looking for answers. If your business, your website, or your file is not where they are looking, you do not exist to the people already asking.

Each episode takes one real thing, a website, a product page, a business listing or a file, and walks through exactly how it becomes findable. What gets submitted, where it goes, how long it takes, and what you can actually measure afterwards. No theory, no ranking promises, and no growth hacks that evaporate. Just the mechanics of visibility, explained for people running small businesses anywhere in the world.

The show is hosted by two AI voices, George and Sarah, and is built from primary sources: search engine documentation, protocol specifications and published research. It is produced with the same pipeline it describes.

New episodes weekly. Made by TSBOI, the visibility company behind tsboi.ai.

title: Q?!!
author: AS_20
description:
Welcome to Q?! — a podcast exploring graphic design, fashion and visual culture. From decoding trends and questioning aesthetics to discussing creative processes, industry insights and the ideas shaping what we see, wear and create. Expect honest opinions, fresh perspectives and conversations that go beyond the surface. Whether you're a designer, fashion enthusiast or simply curious about creativity, there's something here for you.

Stay curious. Keep questioning.

title: The EliteEdge Briefing with Kyle Graham
author: Kyle Graham
description: A weekly briefing for parents and school leaders navigating the complexities of elite education and admissions. Hosted by EliteEdge partner Kyle Graham, this podcast offers provocative, expert, and often unconventional takes on how to build a meaningful path to success.

title: Can I Ask That?
author: Anne
description: If you've got questions about faith, the Bible, or Christianity itself, Anne and Dr. Jim Howard want to hear them. Whether you're curious, skeptical, or searching, this show gives you straight answers without judgment. Dr. Jim brings his PhD in New Testament theology, Anne brings the real questions, and together they make sense of things that usually don't.

title: Twin: Stories of Identical Twins
author: rova
description:
What does it feel like to go through life looking exactly like someone else?

Hosted by Charlotte McLauchlan, Twin goes beyond the science to explore the life of identical twins. Inspired by Charlotte’s own identical great-aunts, two inseparable women who spent their lives together, this podcast explores what it is like to go through life with that deep connection. 

Charlotte dives into what it is like to grow up mirrored and mistaken for someone else, and the lifelong bond of having a built-in best friend.

title: Spin or Skip
author: Travis Holcombe and Famous Friend
description: Good music taste + hot music takes. Hosts Travis Holcombe & Famous Friend present the latest music news, then their guests pick a side: Spin or Skip?

author: Riccardo Beltramo
description: Evidence-based stories on mountain huts as socio-ecological systems, created collaboratively in the Tourism Eco-management course (University of Turin).

title: The Best Things
author: Craig Woodson & Aaron Brooks
description:
Join Craig Woodson and Aaron Brooks as they tackle life's most important (and completely unimportant) debates. From movies, music, and food to sports, pop culture, and just about anything else you can think of, no topic is off-limits and no opinion is safe.


With ridiculous arguments, questionable rankings, plenty of laughs, and a healthy dose of friendly competition, Craig and Aaron are on a mission to settle the debates nobody asked them to settle but everybody has an opinion about.

title: Pop Goes The Wheezer
author: Lawson
description: Intro and Outro Audio is "Fantasia" by Kevin Macleod

title: The Change Makers Tasmania: Science, Spirituality & Healing
author: The Change Makers Tasmania
description:
Welcome to The Change Makers Tasmania, a space where science, spirituality, and healing meet to support real personal transformation.

Whether you are curious about holistic wellness, navigating emotional and physical healing, or looking for practical tools to calm your nervous system, this podcast is designed to bridge evidence-based insight with grounded spiritual wisdom.


Each week, you will explore:

  • Spiritual Changemaker and Innovator Interviews: Honest conversations with healers, practitioners, and inspiring voices making a meaningful impact in Australia nd beyond.
  • Science & Therapy Insights: Accessible, research-backed episodes designed to demystify therapy and help you feel safe opening up to deeper healing.
  • Healing Meditations: Guided audio practices designed  to help you release stress, reset your energy, and reconnect with yourself.


Ready to take your practice deeper? 

  • Visit our website to access free downloadable audios and discover our 3-part guided audio course designed to help you be more receptive to therapies: https://thechangemakers.com.au/reset-ready
  • explore our YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@TheChangeMakersChannel


Subscribe now and join an align, heal, and elevate community dedicated to conscious growth, inner calm, and lasting change.

title: The Knowledge Gap
author: Mimr Studio
description:
Information is everywhere. Understanding is harder.

The Knowledge Gap explores the distance between what organisations know and what people can actually use.

Hosted by Simon and Ross from Mimr Studio, the podcast examines how knowledge is created, communicated, trusted and kept up to date.

From artificial intelligence and digital learning to leadership, professional judgement and the challenges of regulated industries, we explore what happens when information meets the real world.

title: Enhancement Mental Ability

description: Mental age ability describes how your thinking, reasoning, and emotional maturity compare to what is typical for people at different ages. It is not the same as your birth certificate age. Someone who is 25 might show the calm judgment and planning skills of a 40-year-old, while another person might enjoy the playful curiosity of a teenager well into adulthood. Mental age draws on things like problem-solving, memory, decision-making, self-control, and how you handle stress and relationships. These traits shift with life experience, environment, and personality, so your mental age can feel different from one day to the next. If you are curious where you stand, you can try a quick, fun assessment at https://mentalagecheck.com/ and see how your answers compare to different age groups. Treat the result as a light-hearted guide to self-reflection rather than a scientific diagnosis, and use it as a starting point for understanding your own habits, strengths, and growth areas.

description:
Marseille, 1815. Edmond Dantès is nineteen, about to be made captain of his own ship and about to marry the girl he loves. Three men want what he has: his command, his fiancée, and his silence. A letter is written, a magistrate buries the truth to protect his own father, and Dantès disappears into the island fortress of the Château d’If without ever learning what he is accused of.

Fourteen years later a man climbs out of the sea off the coast of Italy. He has a dead priest’s education, a fortune from a buried hoard on the island of Monte Cristo, and a plan that will take years to unfold. One by one he enters the lives of the men who buried him — now a banker, a prosecutor and a count of France — and begins, patiently and almost invisibly, to take everything from them.

First published between 1844 and 1846, The Count of Monte Cristo is Alexandre Dumas’s greatest novel and the most famous revenge story ever written: a sweeping adventure of betrayal, imprisonment, hidden treasure and ruthless retribution that has never been out of print.

When the king discovers that his beloved daughter has fallen in love with a young man beneath her royal standing, he condemns the forbidden lover to face this cruel trial. But the princess secretly discovers what lies behind each door. Torn between saving the man she loves and watching him marry another woman, she must make an impossible choice. As the young man looks to her for guidance, one silent gesture determines his fate. This thought-provoking American literary classic explores love, betrayal, jealousy, human nature, and the uncertain boundaries between justice and cruelty. Famous for its mysterious ending, The Lady, or the Tiger? remains one of literature's most intriguing short stories.

title: The Black Dahlia Murder
author: Jacky
description:
In January 1947, Los Angeles became the center of one of America's most disturbing and mysterious murder investigations. A young woman named Elizabeth Short was found murdered in a vacant lot, and the shocking circumstances of her death captured the attention of the entire nation. Newspapers quickly gave her the nickname "The Black Dahlia," transforming her tragic story into one of the most infamous unsolved cases in American criminal history.

This two-part true crime podcast explores the life of Elizabeth Short, the circumstances surrounding her disappearance and murder, the investigation that followed, and the numerous unanswered questions that continue to surround her case.

The first episode introduces Elizabeth Short, her dreams of Hollywood, her final known movements, and the discovery that shocked Los Angeles. The second episode examines the police investigation, suspicious letters, false confessions, possible suspects, and the theories that have kept the mystery alive for decades.

Through historical details and investigative storytelling, Shadows of Justice separates documented facts from speculation while exploring how media sensationalism transformed a young woman's identity into a lasting mystery.

Nearly eight decades later, one question remains: Who killed Elizabeth Short?

description:
I'm Belle, an Australian-born abstract painter, poet and essayist.

In the studio there's always a moment when I have to stop: the colour is down, the canvas is wet, and nothing more can happen until it dries. Life works the same way. Sometimes we have to wait, be patient, and pause long enough to take in everything colourful the world gives us: the joy and the grief, the people and places that shape our story. That's when I write.

Waiting for Paint to Dry is what I make in those pauses: short readings of my poems, essays and pieces of memoir, each with a few words about where it came from. I write about womanhood and love, the self and digital culture, and finding my way in the world as a woman, an immigrant and a researcher. It's an invitation to slow down with me, living in story and loving in colour.

Painting with my heart and my hands. Living in story, loving in colour.
